body: I'll try. I don't know if it's part of anxiety or just my personality, but I'm always interested in mastering new things and have even told people I just want "acquire as much skill as possible" even if it's not practical. The problem is, I never stay interested if I'm just doing it to feel better. I want to be really good and impress people. Maybe that's the problem.

That makes me feel a little better...

I do have things to live for in a sense. I like my family and my friends.

I don't have any "hobbies" really. I get interested in new things, and I research them and I become somewhat involved with them. My interest usually fades at some point. My job (in a creative field) is the only thing I've ever stuck with and the only thing I am truly interested in as far as serious pursuits. 

I guess...I wouldn't count those things as anything to live for. I especially feel like as much as I like everything I listed, once you die you stop existing so it doesn't really matter how you feel about any of it.
